version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 1.1.1 - FIX: a class change request that was taken back before it ran no longer stays pending. FIX: ride maps and the TRACKER preview no longer show a stale curve after a tempo change. FIX: very long audio blocks no longer drop CC events (the MIDI merge now streams instead of a capped queue). INFO: the SCREAM tooltip now says the class limits apply to sections you have not edited. DOC: eight manual pictures are now declared in @provides. 1.1.0 - Speed Bump Open (one-bar loop) and Evolve 4 Bars (four-bar loop): cutoff rides for basslines. 1.0.0 - FIX: during playback, a class change glided the smoothed output of untouched sections outside the still-valid limits of the new class for a long time (regression of the 0.9.5 fix). The smoothed value now respects the new limits from the first tick after the change; edited sections and live overrides keep the full 0-100 range. The REAPER full test covers this with its own probe. 0.9.6 - NEW: MOVEMENT is an LFO panel for the focus lane (cutoff, resonance, env mod, decay, accent): AMP (depth), RATE in SYNC (16th steps) or HZ, waveform, and a live picture of the LFO over the section. Every lane has its own LFO now (until 0.9.5 only the cutoff swing could be set, the other lanes wobbled with fixed values). - NEW: each node of a lane carries its own AMP and RATE: the start, every own point and the end. Choose the node with NODE, a handle or point in the map, or a mark in the LFO display; depth and speed glide from node to node (the phase never jumps). ALL changes every node at once. The unit switch SYNC / HZ keeps the speed. - NEW: RANDOM also rolls the LFO of each lane: shape, SYNC or HZ, and an own AMP / RATE for the start, each point and the end. - NEW: PREVIEW opens a list of all factory presets (click the middle of the box); a right-click on the box returns to PREVIEW: OFF. - UI: the FROM / TO handles in the lanes are half-rectangles inside their own section (FROM hollow on the right of the bar line, TO solid on the left), so neighbouring sections no longer overlap and it is clear that they move up and down only. - Saved with the project (layout 3; older projects still load) and in user presets. Without an own LFO every lane sounds exactly as in 0.9.5. - FIX: the MOVEMENT preview of a lane without an own LFO now draws the wobble actually sent (fixed sine with its own phase and the absolute step count), not a curve starting at phase 0 - untouched lanes 1-4 showed the wrong phase. - FIX: test commands 7-15 clamp the section index to the real number of sections (a stray index could reach into unused memory). - FIX: the import service now also raises the result counter when the instance is not found - the front saw that failure only after the next success. - FIX: the TRACKER preview hint no longer promises a clamp to the class limits - they are a guide only, the full 0-100 range can be used. 0.9.5 - NEW: DESK, PADS and TRACKER use the full height of the window: tall mixer strips and scene pads in DESK, big section pads and a larger XY field in PADS, 28 rows and tall section previews in TRACKER. Flat buttons, switches and selectors; the window is 10 % wider (more room for the lanes); the LEN selector fits LEN 256 BARS. - FIX: smoothed CC values in untouched sections respect the current class limits immediately after a class change; edited sections and live overrides retain the full 0-100 range. 0.9.0 - NEW: own points in the lanes. Double-click a line (or a lane) of the selected section to add a point, drag it (quarter-bar grid, Shift = free and fine), right-click or Alt+click deletes it; up to 16 points per lane and section; the lane bar next to PREVIEW joins them LINEAR / SMOOTH / STEPS, CLEAR removes them. Saved with the project and in user presets, the TRACKER marks lanes that have points. NEW swing shape SAW DOWN (falls, then jumps up). - NEW: the class limits are a guide, no longer a wall: once you edit a section, every knob, handle, point, XY field and table cell can use the whole lane 0-100 (the green sweet-spot band and the thin limit lines stay as a guide; untouched sections still follow the class table exactly). - UI: taller lane area: MAP panel 522 -> 732 design pixels (+40.23%), RACK+ panel 226 -> 436; front 900 x 910 (125%: 1125 x 1138). - NEW: MAX / key M maximizes one lane to the full height of the map (RACK+ and MAP) for fine editing; lane buttons at the left switch the lane. Crosshair with bar and value under the pointer, value grid, bar lines that get finer with the zoom, bar numbers, a soft fill under the curve. - NEW: flat look for buttons, switches, selectors, tabs and pads (LED switches, accent-filled active state, thin outlines); the window is 10 % wider (990 x 910 grid) so the lanes get more room; the LEN selector is wider so LEN 256 BARS fits. - NEW: RANDOM scope BLOCK (only the focus lane of the selected section); RANDOM got its own header row with an AMOUNT slider and a TARGET line; the map moved down a little. - NEW: RANDOM (button, mouse wheel = amount, key R): rolls FROM / TO around the class table, swing shape / depth / period, ride and sometimes own points; range SECTION / LANE / ALL; stays inside the class limits; volume lane and ON switches are never touched. - NEW: REGIONS. The regions (or markers) of the REAPER project become the sections of the arrangement, through the ReaScripts "TT-KNOBMOVER Import Regions" (one-off action) and "TT-KNOBMOVER Import Service" (makes the REGIONS button work). Types are guessed from the names, bars are rounded, START BAR is set. - NEW: all 46 factory presets reworked, 16 new ones (Steps 32, Saw 32, Tri 64, Wub 48 in four classes): every section has a movement variant (shape, depth, period, own points) relative to the class table, so a drop does not repeat the previous one; a class change re-applies the variants of unedited sections. - Project and preset data now hold 232 words per section (layout version 2; projects and user presets from 0.8.0 and earlier still load). A project that is read (load, undo) is handed to the single writer of the arrangement instead of being written directly. - At the default settings and without variants the CC output is the same as in 0.8.0. - FIX: stopping playback with the cursor back on the start position sends the start values again; choosing a section with FOLLOW SONG off sends its values while stopped; the position display with REPEAT before START BAR shows 0; a truncated project state falls back to the factory arrangement in the chosen class. 0.8.0 - Five views in one plug-in, chosen by tabs in the header: RACK+ (as before), MAP (the whole song as a large map with all six lanes, including volume), DESK (one channel strip per knob with the FROM / TO range of the selected section, live value and CC meter, eight scene pads), PADS (sixteen section pads and an XY field that rides cutoff and resonance by hand and springs back on release) and TRACKER (every section as a row of numbers: FROM / TO per knob, length, swing, period, ride; drag, wheel or keys to edit). Map zoom and scroll as in TT-ACIDLAB: + / - / FIT, Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms around the pointer, the wheel scrolls, scroll bar. Keyboard: Left / Right select a section (Alt: length -/+ 1 bar), Home / End, [ and ] pick the lane, Up / Down change its TO value (Alt: FROM), Page Up / Down by 10, O switches the lane on or off, Delete removes the section, + / - / F zoom. Preset preview: any factory preset can be shown in the map without loading it and without sending anything; LOAD takes it over. Pads and scene pads switch at the next bar (QUANTIZE NEXT BAR, can be turned off); with FOLLOW SONG off the chosen section loops. Edits are handed to the audio thread atomically: the CC engine works on its own copy that is only taken over while the front is not writing, so a block can no longer send a half-edited value (fix of the open finding from the external code review). UI kit 7 modules. - NEW: DESK > MOVE per lane (cutoff, resonance, env mod, decay, accent; 0 to 200 %, default 100 %): how strongly the lane swings around its FROM / TO line in every section. Saved with the project and in user presets. - NEW: PADS > SCREAM (0 to 100 %, default 0): pushes resonance up and env mod down towards the scream class, inside the class limits. - NEW: PADS > NOTE TRIGGER (default off, channel 16, base C2): notes BASE to BASE + 15 on the trigger channel select sections 1 to 16 like the pads (QUANTIZE applies) and are not passed on. - At the default settings the CC output is the same as before. - FIX: PASS NOTES off: an overlapping dropped note-on no longer overwrites a note-on that was passed on, so its note-off still goes through (no hanging note on the TT-303). - FIX: a truncated project chunk falls back to the factory data instead of a half-loaded state; test commands 4 and 6 clamp their indices. 0.3.0 - RIDE MAP: values can be edited vertically in the lanes (as in the MOVER tab of TT-ACIDLAB): drag the START (hollow) or END (solid) dot of the selected section up or down, drag the line between them to move both together, Shift = fine; a FILL section turns into fixed values when edited. The ring dots of the section knobs now mark the lowest and highest value the section really reaches (ramp plus swing, within the class limits) instead of the ramp ends; the START / END sliders are labelled FROM / TO (they stay the ramp ends, sound unchanged). 0.2.0 - 46 factory presets (loops of 8 bars up to a 256-bar marathon, each in all four classes); arrangements up to 256 bars and 64 sections (LEN list 8 to 256); knob rows in the SECTION and MOVEMENT panels moved down so the sweet-spot arcs no longer cross the panel title. Fixes from the external code review: a MIDI channel change re-sends every lane on the new channel; slider changes re-evaluate at once while stopped (SEND CC 7, START BAR, INTENSITY); playback started between two grid points sends the start values immediately; SMOOTH never leaves the class limits after a class change; PASS NOTES: a note-off whose note-on was dropped is dropped too; the preset modified-star uses two sums; a damaged chunk is no longer half-read; the position display follows REPEAT; the LEN box can reach every list entry. - NEW: OPTIONS > AUTO FIT ON / OFF (default on): dragging the window edge rescales the UI to the new window size; the UI SIZE buttons still set a fixed zoom until the window changes again. UI SIZE now accepts 25 to 400 percent. Saved per instance. 0.1.0 - First version: front K6 RACK+ (ride map with section band and five lanes, five live knobs with START / END per section, MOVEMENT with swing, period, ride and shape, section tools, output panel), CC engine after the section tables of the TT-303 pattern generator, preset bar with six factory presets, live override per knob.

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 1.6.0 - Front: the processing is easier to follow. MONITOR shows the processing order as stages (IN > COND > EUCLID > CHANCE > MUTATE > HUMAN > STRUM > RATCH > OUT; lit = enabled, the dot flashes when a stage handles a note) and a DROPS row that splits EV DROP by cause (COND, EUCLID, CHANCE, MUTATE, QUEUE; the five add up to EV DROP). COND shows OPEN / CLOSED and the bar position in its cycle. The EUCLID ring marks the last checked note (green = pulse, amber = veto). MUTATE has a hit LED; its target CHANCE is now shown as GATE FLIP (same setting, presets unchanged). HUMAN DEVIATE shows the last note's final velocity change and delay, STRUM the last added strum delay, RATCHET the last scheduled hit count. Knobs in HUMAN DEVIATE and EUCLID & MUTATE are centred; LED flashes run on time instead of frame rate; SEED tooltips explain FREE and LOCKED more precisely. MIDI processing and random sequences unchanged. 1.5.1 - Fixes from a code review. Notes: switching ENABLED off and on while keys are held no longer leaves a note hanging (BYPASS now keeps track of held notes, so the note-offs of notes that were already closed are swallowed instead of doubled); two notes on the same key that touch (legato) are no longer cut short under TIME DEV, STRUM or RATCHET shifts; release velocity is passed through; more than 512 events in one block no longer lose note-offs; EV OUT / PASS count notes actually sent; STRUM ALT only alternates on real chords (a single note between chords no longer flips the direction); a loop jump no longer fires a panic in BYPASS; time-signature changes just behind a block start are anchored independent of the block size (COND after a change), earlier provisional anchors no longer hide learned ones, large blocks no longer count a continuation as a jump; the random stream is seeded already at load (SEED works before the first play); the PRNG avoids 64-bit modulo on 32-bit builds (same sequences on 64-bit); the preset modified-star (*) no longer cancels out and survives project reopen/undo; factory presets load in one step; the front's font fitting does far less work at large font sizes; wheel on the SEED box counts notches; preset bar and OPTIONS: a click on OPTIONS (scrollbars over the bar) no longer also loads a preset, no phantom click when an overlay ends under a held mouse button, a stale key no longer ends SAVE at once, a damaged bank is reported as BANK DAMAGED, UI SIZE accepts 0 (clamped to 50 %). Release-velocity-sensitive instruments now sound as they would without the plug-in. Audio otherwise unchanged. Decisions kept open (they would change the random decisions of projects with a locked SEED): loop passes with a locked SEED still differ, parameter automation across zero still shifts the random stream. - NEW: OPTIONS > AUTO FIT ON / OFF (default on): dragging the window edge rescales the UI to the new window size; the UI SIZE buttons still set a fixed zoom until the window changes again. UI SIZE now accepts 25 to 400 percent. Saved per instance. - Internal: the random generator and the event loop no longer share scratch variables with the front (rare, non-reproducible random draws with a locked SEED are ruled out); UI kit module updated. Audio otherwise unchanged. 1.5.0 - Eight new factory presets in the preset bar: Guitar Strum Alt, Harp Sweep 45ms, Chord Dice 30ms, Fill Roll 4 Bars, Phrase Break 8 Bars, Trap Hat Stutter, Tresillo 3-3-2, Ghost Accents (13 in all; the first five keep their place). Internal: a note-timing table moved in memory so the preset bank can grow (more than ten factory presets would have overlapped it), with a memory guard at load. DSP/audio otherwise unchanged. 1.4.1 - Internal: the front's substitute fonts (used when a text does not fit its field at large OPTIONS font sizes) no longer use font slot 11, which belongs to the preset bar - the bar could be drawn in the wrong font or the substitute text overwritten. DSP/audio and look at font size 0 unchanged. 1.4.0 - STRUM RAND draws its chord order from a separate seeded random stream per chord: with a locked SEED the result is now the same at every block size (playback, render, freeze), and RAND no longer shifts the CHANCE / VEL / TIME / MUTATE decisions. Projects with a locked SEED and STRUM RAND play different (but again reproducible) decisions than 1.3.5. COND follows time-signature changes during playback: bars restart at every time-signature marker (playback starting behind a change counts from the current signature until the change has been played through once). Front: texts no longer run into neighbouring controls at large OPTIONS font sizes. 1.3.5 - Persistent UI size and options; larger default, stable colours when zooming. 1.3.4 - Fixes: a transport start now closes every sounding and pending note (pending strum / time-deviation / ratchet note-offs were lost before, notes could hang); CC 120 / CC 123 now pass through to the instrument and clear only the notes of their own channel; overlapping notes of the same pitch under STRUM / TIME DEV can no longer hang; a full output queue drops whole new notes instead of losing note-offs (ratchet bursts stay complete). Mouse wheel moves whole-number knobs one step per detent. Test commands need the test-script handshake. Manual: STRUM RAND is not promised bit-identical across renders; COND counts bars from one time signature. 1.3.3 - OPTIONS box: TOOLTIPS ON / OFF (per instance, saved with the project); tooltips on every control; version shown on the front; preset bar / OPTIONS tooltips via tt_modtips; DSP/audio unchanged 1.3.2 - review fixes: note-ons dropped by the input-cap fallback now count into EV IN; EV readout sliders widened to 999999; DSP/MIDI behaviour unchanged 1.3.1 - OPTIONS box: fully clamped inside the window incl. shadow; footer no longer overlaps the colour picker; user preset bank stays loadable when the chunk was saved with fewer slots; DSP/audio unchanged 1.3.0 - Front ported to the current UI kit look (v2): gradient ground, titled shadow panels, polished knobs, combo selectors, LED toggles, level meter, product subtitle, corner screws. OPTIONS box gains FONT SIZE controls and a custom HSV colour picker (FONT 1 / FONT 2 / BG) via shared theme module v2. Window 700x460, preset bar at standard 250 units. Same controls and parameters, DSP unchanged. 1.2.0 - Preset bar in the header (left of OPTIONS): 5 factory presets + 32 user slots stored in the plug-in state (project, FX chain, REAPER preset files). Header rearranged (ENABLED/SEED cluster moved). New hidden test sliders 41-45. DSP unchanged. 1.1.0 - OPTIONS box with COLOR (10 schemes): button in the header, hidden slider 40 (UI Color, factory ACID), front themed. 1.0.0 - Initial release: probability engine, condition modes, strum, ratchet, velocity/time deviation, euclidean patterns, mutation, deterministic XorShift32 PRNG, UIKit front panel

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 1.07 - Sound engine recalibrated against reference recordings: 4-pole VCF at the TB-303 pole positions, much stronger resonance, lower cutoff floor (~100 Hz), decay range 25-570 ms, fast VEG sag after the attack (shorter, punchier steps), accent network (latch + RC) with audible accent tail, 6 ms release - SLIDE time now sets the arrival time (~95 %) instead of the time constant - Square with pitch-dependent duty; 7-tap half-band decimation - Hotter distortion (more drive and presence tilt) and +12 dB output make-up: 1.07 is noticeably louder than 1.0 - lower VOLUME if needed - New EQ defaults: drive EQ fully open, delay 300 Hz-2.8 kHz, reverb 300 Hz-2.5 kHz (header and INIT) - The preset bar shows the active preset again after loading a project - Fixes: same-pitch overlaps in HOST mode; held notes are released on transport stop; step at the loop end no longer fires twice; tie after All-Notes-Off no longer silent; UNDO restores the right bank and survives transport start; no hanging notes on SEQ OUT; MIDI transpose counts keys, not events; TUNING/FINE and MIDI CC act immediately; INIT resets all sound controls - COPY creates an undo point for the target bank - Wordmark font name corrected to "Zilap Orion" 1.0.1 - Wordmark font name corrected to "Zilap Orion" 1.0 - First full release

version.changelog: 2.0.0 - First ReaPack release since 1.07. Renumbered from 1.5.0: ReaPack reads 1.07 as 1.7, so 1.5.0 would not be offered as an update. Includes all changes listed below. 1.5.0 - HOST mode aligned further with the Devil Fish MIDI In: note stack 10 deep (oldest falls out), sustain on CC 64 (gate stays on while CC 64 >= 64), accent velocity default 65 with the four Devil Fish thresholds 65/80/100/120 on a DF button; existing projects and presets keep their stored accent velocity 1.4.1 - HOST mode as the Devil Fish MIDI In: a note-on for a key that is already on is ignored (no retrigger, no hanging note); the first note-off ends it 1.4.0 - HOST mode: an overlapping note of the same pitch was struck again (replaced by 1.4.1) 1.3.4 - Persistent UI size and options; larger default, stable colours when zooming 1.07 - Sound engine recalibrated against reference recordings; slide time sets the arrival time; hotter distortion and +12 dB output make-up (noticeably louder); several HOST/SEQ fixes

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 2.1.4 - FIX: switching SEQ OUT off while a sequencer note was still playing dropped its note-off - the receiving instrument kept the note hanging (for many steps on slide chains or 100 % gate). The pending note-off is now sent once when SEQ OUT switches off. @provides header cleaned (stray PATGEN entries removed, keyboard image added). Sound unchanged. 2.1.3 - FIX: the space bar now always starts and stops the REAPER transport while the plugin window has focus (the plugin no longer asks REAPER for all keyboard input). Type a space in a name field with Shift+Space. 2.1.2 - FIX: dragging quickly across the keyboard could leave a note hanging; the note-off of the previous key now follows immediately (the slide stays). The LO and HI handles of an effect EQ can be separated again when they sit on top of each other. Value labels under the sequencer knobs and the EQ strips keep their spacing at large UI sizes. The keyboard tooltip fits the window. 2.1.1 - NEW: the factory presets are now the default presets of the web version (TT-Groove, TT-BigBoy, TT-HiImTom!, TT-OffbeatBaby, TT-GoodStart, INIT). Each one loads its sound AND its four pattern banks A-D (the previous INIT, DEEP, SQUELCH, SCREAM, HOOVER and DUB are gone). Mode, free run, SEQ OUT and MIDI THRU stay as they are; the tempo follows the host. 2.1.0 - The keyboard in HOST mode is playable: click a key to play it, click lower on the key to play harder (accent from ACCENT VEL), drag to another key to slide. SLIDE moved from the effects row (it sat next to REVERB) into the SYNTHESIZER panel, now nine knob columns. CUTOFF, RESONANCE, ENV MOD and VOLUME are smoothed (5 ms, no zipper noise when turning with the mouse); MIDI CC takes effect at its sample offset. AUTO FIT: the UI zoom follows the window size again (switch in OPTIONS). Fixed: user presets lost Distortion ON/OFF; the reverb bypass could be corrupted while the SEQ front was open; the filter coefficient did not follow the resonance at the cutoff ceiling; the changed-star of the preset bar was lost after loading a project. 2.0.0 - First ReaPack release since 1.07 (ACID SEASON, 05.10.2026). Existing projects and presets keep their stored accent velocity. 1.4.1 - HOST mode as the Devil Fish MIDI In: a note-on for a key that is already on is ignored (no retrigger, no hanging note); the first note-off ends it. 1.4.0 - HOST mode: an overlapping note of the same pitch was struck again (replaced by 1.4.1). 1.3.4 - Persistent UI size and options; larger default, stable colours when zooming.

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 1.1.0 - NEW: OFFSET per lane (EXPERT knob row and a start grip in the WAVE page / FUSION EXPAND): moves the start of a lane on the time axis, -100..+100 ms (S1: 0..+100 ms), 0.1 ms steps - positive = later (a gap), negative = earlier (more overlap); the lanes after it move with it. Default 0 = the kick sounds exactly as in 1.0.1. FIT LENGTH TO and the WAVE preview include it. Saved with the project and in user presets (older projects load with 0). Lane import: one more value per lane. Review 30.10.2026: FIX sample rebuild slot publication, truncated state rejection, preset undo snapshots and delta-based XF dragging (format/version unchanged). 1.0.1 - NEW: hidden parameter 'Lane request (Lua)' - a ReaScript can write lane sounds (the 16 sound parameters of up to three lanes, like a lane preset) into exactly one TT-KICK instance; values are range-checked, one undo step, old values are never applied again. 1.0.0 - NEW: first release. Three sequential lanes (TRANSIENT / BODY / TAIL) with equal-power crossfades, each SYNTH (phase-coherent engines) or SAMPLE (loaded via Lua actions or captured live); EXPERT knobs (F0 / F1 with note names), lane filter, mute / solo, RAND and lane preset browsers; per-lane zoom with - / + / ZOOM FIT and scroll bar, stored in presets; FUSION row with SUM / STACK / EXPAND, FIT LENGTH TO and AUTO; WAVE view of the real waveform with the WAVE page; master rack (filter, drive, clip, output); built-in 4/4 player with SYNC / FREE RUN and swing; INIT + 44 factory kicks and a 32-slot user bank; 20-step undo; OPTIONS with ten colour schemes, UI SIZE, AUTO FIT and tooltips; sample loaders per instance and an export action.

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: v1.1.0 (2026-10-26) NEW: factory preset FAST 148 [VERB/MODAL] - short T60 2 s rumble with HC 120 Hz for 145-150 BPM (START 8, ATT 45, HLD 60, REL 120 ms); appended as preset 22, the other numbers stay. FIX (Review 30.10.2026): preserve bank/style on restore before init, validate before DSP seeds, and cancel pending legacy time conversion when presets or FIT supply milliseconds. State format unchanged. v1.0.0 (2026-10-25) RELEASE: three factory presets removed after the user hearing round (Abnahme matrix): SCHRANZ ("very noisy, no real rumble") and RUBBLE ROLL (failed) and GRAIN SMEAR (failed). The bank is now INIT + 21 presets (8 VERB / 7 NOISE / 6 PITCH); later slots shifted down by one or three, so a project that stored a factory preset by number loads a different design than before - your own user presets are unaffected. The GRAIN window stays available as an engine character. Sound of the remaining presets unchanged. Same state raises the version to 1.0.0 for the Drop 04 release; UI kit 8, no other changes. FIX (review round 6): the preset bar kept its old factory count (PBK_NF 25) and listed three phantom "TONAL 41" entries after the removal; it now follows PSET_N (22 entries). v0.9.4 (2026-10-24) FIX: a project save no longer clamps parameters or clears the modified star - state validation and the star reset now run only when a chunk is READ, as the code already claimed. FIX: the AHDR curve tooltip now describes the ms times (0-24000, independent of tempo) instead of the percentage model dropped in 0.9.0. Sound unchanged. v0.9.3 (2026-10-17) FIX: tooltips added for the CLIP LED and the KICK / RUMBLE percent readouts; a project chunk cut off inside the parameter block now loads the factory state instead of a mix of old and stored values; the latency delay line can no longer read one word past its ring in a rounding edge case. About text updated (dry kick is delayed since 0.9.2). Sound unchanged. v0.9.2 (2026-10-15) FIX: query the graphics keyboard state each frame without consuming typed characters, so SHIFT+wheel works before opening any preset or OPTIONS text entry (this fix itself does not touch the audio). NEW: 23 factory presets replaced after the kick-rumble guide (BOOM E1 kept, slot 9): rolling, hypnotic, tight, offbeat, industrial, raw, peak-time, noise, grit, comb, pitch layers; all times in ms for roughly 135-145 BPM. - NEW: LATENCY (PITCH shifts the kick by half its window): the kick is now delayed by the engine latency and reported to the host (PDC), so the rumble starts exactly with the kick at START 0 ms. LAT AUTO follows the engine (VERB/NOISE 0 ms), LAT FIXED always reports one window (about 85 ms at 48 kHz) so the latency never changes when the engine or character is switched. Saved per instance. v0.9.1 (2026-10-15) FIX: legacy envelope conversion waits for the first audio block and its actual host tempo. Before processing, pending legacy states remain v2 when saved; old user presets use the last audio-block tempo. Fixes 120-BPM fallback during project loading and stale tempo during live state restore. v0.9.0 (2026-10-15) START / ATTACK / HOLD / RELEASE use independent milliseconds (0-24000 ms), with 1 ms wheel and 0.1 ms fine wheel. No automatic squeezing or tempo scaling. FIT TO scales once to a note. Old projects and user presets convert their effective times at load tempo; factory timings preserve their 130 BPM sound. State v3 / preset layout 2, same memory map and word counts. v0.8.0 (2026-10-15) PITCH: more accurate cubic read heads (causal fallback near the write head, no added latency); ring indices wrap safely even after floating-point rounding; playback rate now follows a triggered window change in the same sample instead of waiting for the next block. Engine, character and cut-type changes join the previous output through a 5 ms raised-cosine correction. DRIVE skips the inactive shaper and caches the exact gain compensation. UNDO tooltip correctly describes up to 19 edits in its 20-slot ring. Saved state, factory values and dry path unchanged. v0.7.1 (2026-10-14) INTERNAL: UI kit 7 modules (shared building blocks); no change to sound or presets. v0.7.0 (2026-10-09) New front: the scope is now the centre piece. It shows the incoming KICK and the RUMBLE together on one scale, optionally the SUM and the envelope GATE line, with the S/A/H/R gate windows drawn over every beat. FIXED view holds one bar still while a cursor redraws it; ROLL scrolls. The controls sit in five groups underneath (TRIGGER, ENGINE, ENVELOPE with a curve preview, FILTER, MIX). Sound and presets unchanged. - NEW: OPTIONS > AUTO FIT ON / OFF (default on): dragging the window edge rescales the UI to the new window size; the UI SIZE buttons still set a fixed zoom until the window changes again. UI SIZE now accepts 25 to 400 percent. Saved per instance. v0.6.1 (2026-10-09) PITCH: the first hit after a CHARACTER or preset change is no longer up to 8.6 dB too quiet (the delay is now planned with the new window size); clicking OPTIONS no longer loads a neighbouring preset when the window shows scrollbars; a mouse button held down from the preset bar no longer triggers a click elsewhere; the modified-star survives reloading a project and undo; stray keystrokes no longer end the preset name entry; invalid (NaN) values in a damaged project are cleaned up on load; VERB tail no longer leaves denormal numbers behind after silence. v0.6.0 (2026-10-02) P26: factory presets DARK CARPET (START 10 %) and SUB DROP (START 20 %) open their gate again under a straight 4/4 kick (with 50 % they stayed silent / barely came through); PITCH snaps to whole semitones (one wheel notch = one semitone; saved off-grid values load and sound unchanged until turned); the rumble keeps running when playback starts (no more buffer flush at every transport start - tails ring out, no click); NOISE level and COMB range no longer depend on the sample rate (identical at 48 kHz; at 96/192 kHz NOISE was 3/6 dB quieter, at 44.1 kHz 0.4 dB louder); large OPTIONS font steps no longer make front texts overlap (texts that do not fit are drawn a step smaller) 0.5.5 - Persistent UI size and options; larger default, stable colours when zooming. v0.5.4 (2026-10-02) P25 review fixes: every edit now tells REAPER (undo point "Edit FX", project marked as changed - before, closing REAPER after RUMBLER-only edits lost them without asking); UNDO also records mouse-wheel moves and right-click resets; OPTIONS > TOOLTIPS is the one tooltip switch (header TIPS switch removed, old projects keep their setting); header version no longer slides onto UNDO at some window sizes; MIX divider no longer crosses the faders; tooltips show up to four lines; PITCH shows one decimal (it always played continuously); loading a preset or UNDO no longer touches the KICK/RUMBLE switches or the colour for a moment; CLIPPER OFF / DRIVE 0 settle to exact bypass after ~0.2 s instead of ~15 s; first PITCH hit after a sample-rate change uses the new window; shared modules updated (THEME 4 / UIKIT 4); DSP otherwise unchanged v0.5.3 (2026-10-01) P23: OPTIONS box: TOOLTIPS ON / OFF (per instance, saved with the project; the TIPS switch in the header is the same setting); tooltips on every control incl. the preset bar and the OPTIONS button; DSP/audio unchanged v0.5.2 (2026-10-01) P22 review fixes: ENGINE=PITCH no longer loads as NOISE when a project chunk is read before @init (validateState gated on rmbInit); PITCH window size changes on CHARACTER now apply at the next trigger instead of jumping the read position mid-tail (click); dead per-sample peak computation removed. Sound unchanged with steady settings. v0.5.1 (2026-10-01) P22: OPTIONS box: fully clamped inside the window incl. shadow; footer no longer overlaps the colour picker; user preset bank stays loadable when the chunk was saved with fewer slots; DSP/audio unchanged v0.5.0 (2026-10-01) P21: front rebuilt on the shared v2 UI kit (tt-uikit.jsfx-inc, spliced into @init): uikit_begin + cached ground, panel2 panels with title bar, knob2 / hslider / combo / toggle widgets; header with wordmark, subtitle, preset bar and OPTIONS - same look and handling as the other TimTechlor plugins. The inhouse kit copies (xrect .. btn) and the old cell-knob system (kbArc/knob/kbTxtDraw/kbTipCell/kbHzTxt) plus the vFade fader are gone. unchanged: CTRL+click = default, SHIFT = fine, right/double- click = default, tooltips (TIPS), UNDO, KICK/RUMBLE mute, theme/preset bar. OPTIONS now also holds FONT SIZE steps and a custom colour picker (FONT 1 / FONT 2 / BG, theme v2), saved per instance via the preset module v2 style block. DSP, serialize blob and user bank untouched - every section except @gfx is byte-identical (besides the spliced THEME/PRESETS/UIKIT module blocks and the APP_VER string). v0.4.0 (2026-09-30) P17: unified preset bar in the header (left of OPTIONS) replaces the < NAME > stepper: factory list (INIT + 24) plus a 32-slot user bank saved with the project/FX chain/native REAPER presets (appended after the 66-word blob, blob format unchanged, old projects load with an empty bank). UNDO also reverts loading a preset. Audio unchanged. v0.3.0 (2026-09-30) P14: OPTIONS box with COLOR (10 schemes: ACID, CYAN, ORANGE, MAGENTA, YELLOW, RED, BLUE, VIOLET, MINT, ICE) - button in the header right of UNDO; factory scheme is ACID (look identical to v0.2.0). The choice lives per instance in the serialized reserve word +35 (blob v2 unchanged, old projects load as ACID), is not part of presets/undo. Audio unchanged. v0.2.0 (2026-09-30) P15: new defaults THRESHOLD -3 dBFS and START 50 % (INIT and all 24 factory presets, CTRL+click reset); MIX: KICK / RUMBLE on/off switches (mute with ~5-10 ms ramp, engine/trigger/AUTO GAIN keep running, not part of presets; params +28/+29, blob v2, v1 blobs load with both on); fixed @serialize load path (project/preset state was discarded on load: file_avail is 0/1 in read mode, magic is float32). v0.1.0 (2026-09-30) initial DSP core build M1/M2: audio/MIDI trigger with hysteresis + debounce, VERB / NOISE / PITCH engines, proportional tempo-synced AHDR (START = delay), resonant low cut, parallel band drive, high cut CLEAN/COMB/DIRTY with ENV DEPTH, feed-forward auto gain with freeze, clipper + ceiling, OUT with safety clamp, 64-word serialize blob v1, undo ring, preset infrastructure (INIT + WAREHOUSE). M3 (same day, Devin): full front in @gfx - header with preset stepper/UNDO/TIPS, TRIGGER (threshold knob, SRC, follower LED bar, big TRIG LED), ENGINE (mode + character buttons, engine-gated knobs), ENVELOPE (AHDR curve display + 5 knobs + LENGTH stepper), FILTER (6 knobs + CUT TYPE), MIX (2 vertical faders, OUT/CEILING knobs, AUTO GAIN/CLIPPER, CLIP LED), output scope and footer. Tooltips runtime-toggleable. M4/M5: 24 factory presets, lab-QA green; PITCH window phase-locks per kick.

Range 25 to 400 %, saved. - NEW NAME: TT Theme Font Editor is now TT-THEMEFONTEDITOR. File name, action and saved settings stay the same. - The version is shown next to the name at the top of the window. - FIX: BAKE THEME right after the first change now finishes the bake after preparing the working copy (before, only the preview was made). - FIX: an incomplete working copy (a file that could not be copied or extracted) is reported and no longer marked as ready. - FIX: baking never deletes the previous export first: the old file is moved aside and only replaced once the new one is in place; if that fails, the old export stays. - FIX: write errors (e.g. a full disk) are detected; a plain theme is written to a temporary file, checked, and only then replaces the target, so no cut-off theme is left behind. - FIX: a missing or unreadable file inside a zipped theme, or a zip write error, stops the bake with "Baking failed: ..." instead of writing an incomplete theme. - FIX: selecting a font larger than 48 px (or smaller than 6 px) no longer changes it; at a fixed large UI size the window scrolls instead of cutting off controls. - NEW: BAKE TO chooses where BAKE THEME writes: CREATE COPY (default) makes a new theme file "<name> (TimTechlor)" next to the original, numbered "(TimTechlor 2)", "(TimTechlor 3)" ... if that name is taken, and never replaces an existing file; OVERWRITE ORIGINAL writes back into the theme you are editing and keeps its previous version as "<name>.bak". The choice is saved; the status line names the file that was written. - FIX: closing the window while the working copy is being prepared or a theme is being baked now stops the job cleanly: files are closed and no half-written theme or temporary file is left behind. - FIX: a change right after baking no longer races with the removal of the old working folder (the folder is renamed before it is deleted in the background).
